lines.en: label beachsixotoha1:
scene sky
The familiar scents of salt water and sunscreen flood my senses as I look to the sky in search of respite from the expected accompanying visual stimulation.
lines.zh: 熟悉的海水和防晒霜的气味涌进我的感官,我抬头望向天空,想从随之而来的视觉刺激里寻得一丝喘息。

lines.en: There is only so much my senses can take at once, and that is precisely why I need to be careful in places like this.
lines.zh: 我的感官一次能承受的就这么多,这也正是我必须在这种地方格外小心的原因。

lines.en: The girls of class 1-A now are not the same girls they were in the past.
lines.zh: 现在的 1-A 班女孩,已经不是过去的她们了。

lines.en: And seeing as a good portion of that (if not all of it) is my fault, I must remain vigilant. I must remain {i}abstinent{/i} so as not to further contaminate them.
lines.zh: 而既然这其中有相当一部分(如果不是全部)是我的错,我就必须保持警惕。我必须保持{i}禁欲{/i},以免进一步污染她们。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha1
...is what I {i}would{/i} be saying if I had not already given up and succumbed to the incessant lust that governs this [[comparably] hulking body.
lines.zh: ……如果我没有早就放弃、屈服于支配着这具〔相对〕庞大的身体的无休止的欲望,我大概{i}就会是{/i}这么说的。

lines.en: I am going to have so much weird and impure sex this weekend. I sure hope there’s no god present to smite me.
lines.zh: 这个周末,我将会经历非常多奇怪又不纯洁的性爱。但愿没有哪位神明在场来降罚于我。

lines.en: : Wow! The weather’s so great today that it might even lessen the impact of whatever impending drama currently hangs over us like clouds!
lines.zh: : 哇!今天天气好到,甚至能减轻正像乌云一样压在我们头顶的那场即将到来的风波带来的冲击!

lines.en: : Couldn’t have said it better myself, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你说得太对了,Ayane。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha2
: Woah! We’ve even got an ominous floating caption that potentially foreshadows our impending doom! So fun!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!我们甚至还有一条不祥的浮动字幕,可能预示着我们即将到来的末日!真有趣!

lines.en: : I’m just glad I’m not the only one who can see it.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴,看得见它的不只我一个人。

lines.en: : Senpai! Senpai!~
lines.zh: : Senpai!Senpai!~

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha3
: You actually came! Not that I was worried you {i}wouldn’t{/i} or anything. But now that you’re here, I’m definitely way less nervous and flighty! Probably just a coincidence.
lines.zh: : 你真的来了!我可不是在担心你{i}不来{/i}什么的。不过既然你来了,我确实没那么紧张、没那么飘了!大概只是巧合。

lines.en: : Hi, Miss Imai. I am here as well, and I am extending my need for attention to you too since you are just girl-Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗨,Imai 小姐。我也在这儿,而且我把求关注的需求也一并伸向了你,毕竟你就是个女版 Sensei。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha4
: Dude, what have I ever done to deserve that sort of slander?
lines.zh: : 老兄,我到底做过什么,要遭这种诽谤?

lines.en: : Imani, I don’t think you’re allowed to like me and also say things like that at the same time.
lines.zh: : Imani,我觉得你不能一边喜欢我,一边又说这种话。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha5
: Racism! You think you can tell me what I can and can’t do just because I’m black, don’t you?!
lines.zh: : 种族歧视!你觉得就因为我是黑人,就能对我指手画脚,不是吗?!

lines.en: : How many times are you going to play that card? You know that makes literally zero difference to me.
lines.zh: : 你这张牌要打多少次?你知道这对我来说真的毫无差别。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha6
: Oh, sorry. My b. Let me try again.
lines.zh: : 哦,抱歉。我的错。让我再试一次。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha5
: Sexism! You think you can tell me what I can and can’t do just because I’m a woman, don’t you?!
lines.zh: : 性别歧视!你觉得就因为我是女人,就能对我指手画脚,不是吗?!

lines.en: : You should really be more accepting of girl-Sensei, boy-Sensei. Your species might even die out at this rate. I only know three of you with character models.
lines.zh: : 男 Sensei,你真该对女 Sensei 更宽容一点。照这个速度下去,你们这个物种说不定会灭绝。我只认识三个有角色建模的你们。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha7
: Is that a caption I see floating away over there?
lines.zh: : 我看见那边飘走的,是一条字幕吗?

lines.en: : No, just the last remaining segment of the fourth wall. Status report, Imani.
lines.zh: : 不是,只是第四面墙最后残存的一块。情况汇报,Imani。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha8
: Only if I get to subsequently debrief you at the end of the day! And Ayane — you didn’t hear that!
lines.zh: : 除非等今天结束的时候,我能好好「复盘」你一下!还有 Ayane——你什么都没听见!

lines.en: : Can I help?
lines.zh: : 我能帮忙吗?

lines.en: : No. You already have Makoto.
lines.zh: : 不行。你已经有 Makoto 了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I want to hear more about Ayane’s sudden lesbian side before this conversation proceeds.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。不过在这场对话继续之前,我想多听听 Ayane 突然冒出来的那一面。

lines.en: : No! Status report is as follows: we are on the beach! {i}Most{/i} of us, at least!
lines.zh: : 不!情况汇报如下:我们在海滩上!至少{i}大部分{/i}人是!

lines.en: : And later, we will be in our respective bedrooms! Which we are {i}not{/i} sharing despite how much I tried to make that happen this year.
lines.zh: : 而稍后,我们会各自回到自己的卧室!尽管今年我费了多大劲想让它成真,我们还是{i}不{/i}共享房间。

lines.en: : And again, Ayane — you didn’t hear that!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,Ayane——你什么都没听见!

lines.en: : We all know about you and Sensei already, Miss Imai. You don’t need to hide it.
lines.zh: : 您和 Sensei 的事我们已经都知道了,Imai 小姐。您不用藏着。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha9
: Aww!~ They’ve already given us their blessing, Senpai! We should stage a fake announcement in front of the class and have one of the girls film it so we can go viral.
lines.zh: : 哇!~ 他们已经祝福我们了,Senpai!我们应该在全班面前搞一场假的官宣,再让哪个女孩录下来,这样我们就能火一把。

lines.en: : Now, I never said I was giving you my- ahh! Sensei?! Did you just {i}push{/i} me?!
lines.zh: : 我可从来没说过要给你我的——啊!Sensei?!你刚才是不是{i}推{/i}了我?!

lines.en: : No, that was the caption.
lines.zh: : 不,是那条字幕。

lines.en: : It wasn’t the- oh my God, it is! Ah! Back! Back, I say! I have a gun!
lines.zh: : 才不是那——我的天,还真是!啊!退后!我说了退后!我有枪!

lines.en: The caption chases Ayane down the beach, leaving just Imani and me. And everyone in the background. Mostly Imani and me.
lines.zh: 那条字幕沿着海滩追着 Ayane 跑,剩下的就只有 Imani 和我。还有背景里的所有人。主要是 Imani 和我。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha10
: Anyway, I’d love to stay and chat more, but I’m organizing a volleyball thing with Karin later and I’ve gotta go help her with that. Come find me tonight, maybe?
lines.zh: : 总之,我也想留下来多聊会儿,不过我待会儿要和 Karin 组织一场排球活动,得去帮她。今晚来找我,怎么样?

lines.en: : Like, sexually?
lines.zh: : 那个,性方面地?

lines.en: : Well, yeah. If I’m gonna debrief you, it sure as hell ain’t gonna be platonic.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对。既然我要「复盘」你,那肯定不是柏拉图式的。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei!

lines.en: : Dad!
lines.zh: : 爸爸!

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha11
: Oh, okay. I guess it’s your turn now.
lines.zh: : 哦,好吧。看来轮到你了。

lines.en: : Hi! Yes. Come hang out with us. Preferably without your shirt on. But only because I am worried about you overheating.
lines.zh: : 嗨!对。来跟我们一起玩吧。最好别穿上衣。不过只是因为我担心你中暑。

lines.en: : Imani already left if that’s what you’re worried about right now.
lines.zh: : 如果你现在担心的是这个的话,Imani 已经走了。

lines.en: : Then, please take your shirt off because you are hot and I want to touch you.
lines.zh: : 那么,请把上衣脱了吧,因为你很热,而我想摸你。

lines.en: : I have also always secretly wanted to touch your abs, so let the record show that I support Chika’s suggestion.
lines.zh: : 我也一直暗地里想摸你的腹肌,所以在此声明:我支持 Chika 的提议。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha12
: Didn’t you just call him your dad?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚不是还叫他爸爸吗?

lines.en: : Yes. But let the record show that this doesn’t make things weird because I’ve never actually had a dad, so calling {i}Sensei{/i} “Dad” isn’t taboo at all and is actually just fun.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过在此声明:这并不让事情变得奇怪,因为我从来没有过爸爸,所以管 {i}Sensei{/i} 叫「爸爸」完全不算禁忌,反而挺好玩的。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha13
: Woo! No dad club!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!无父俱乐部!

lines.en: : That’s like half of the class, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得班里大概有一半人都是。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha14
: Right! Which means we need to find an advisor if we want to make things formal. Which we do! Right now! So come shirtlessly resolve our respective daddy issues!
lines.zh: : 对!也就是说,如果想把这事儿正规化,我们得找个顾问。而我们想!就现在!所以请你光着上身来,帮我们解决各自的父亲情结吧!

lines.en: : Can I at least finish greeting everyone at the beach first? I literally just got here.
lines.zh: : 我能至少先跟海滩上的大家打完招呼吗?我才刚到。

lines.en: : Fine. But only since doing so is your moral obligation.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过只因为这是你的道德义务。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha15
: Great. Then I’ll start with Otoha, who is currently approaching us.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就从 Otoha 开始,她正朝我们走过来。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha16
: Hey.
scene beachsixotoha17
: Am I...interrupting something?
lines.zh: : 我……是不是打扰了什么?

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : {i}No,{/i} Otoha. You are not interrupting anything. And thank you for saving me the steps required to come say hello to you.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i},Otoha。你没有打扰任何事。还有,谢谢你省了我走过去跟你打招呼的这几步。

lines.en: : Do you need something from Sensei, Otoha? I’ve never seen you go out of your way just to say hi to him before.
lines.zh: : Otoha,你找 Sensei 有什么事吗?我从来没见过你特意绕过来就为了跟他打个招呼。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha18
: Don’t talk to her, Rin. She’ll destroy you again.
lines.zh: : 别跟她说话,Rin。她会再毁你一次的。

lines.en: : You’re still being weird about that? That was like, forever ago.
lines.zh: : 你还在为那件事别扭?那都像是好久以前的事了。

lines.en: : Yet the wounds still remain.
lines.zh: : 可伤口还在。

lines.en: : Do they? Because Rin seems pretty cool with me. And, if I remember correctly, at least {i}I{/i} gave her a shot when she confessed.
lines.zh: : 是吗?可 Rin 看起来跟我相处得挺好的。而且如果我没记错的话,她表白的时候,至少{i}我{/i}还给了她一次机会。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha19
: She’s got a point, Chika. And the wound you left probably {i}did{/i} sting a little harder since I liked you for so long. Not that it was actually your fault or anything, though.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理,Chika。而且你留下的那道伤口,大概{i}确实{/i}更疼一点,毕竟我那么久以来都喜欢着你。不过这也不能真的怪你。

lines.en: : That was different! I already had somebody!
lines.zh: : 那不一样!我那时候已经有喜欢的人了!

lines.en: : Wooooah, really? Who could it have possibly been?
lines.zh: : 哇———哦,真的吗?那能是谁呢?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha20
: Do {i}you{/i} know, Sensei? Because I have absolutely nooooo idea who Chika might have feelings for if not my ex-girlfriend. I am in a state of complete and utter cluelessness.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}知道吗,Sensei?因为除了我的前女友之外,我真的是一点、一丁点都不知道 Chika 可能喜欢谁。我正处于一种完全彻底的茫然之中。

lines.en: : Before Chika kills you, is there {i}actually{/i} something you need, Otoha? Or are you really just saying hi?
lines.zh: : 在 Chika 杀了你之前——Otoha,你{i}真的{/i}有事吗?还是说你真的只是来打个招呼?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha21
: Yeah. I’m invoking my privilege as your cool older sister to rescue you from these two girls who clearly want to use your body for their own nefarious purposes.
lines.zh: : 有。我要行使我作为你那超酷的姐姐的特权,把你从这两个显然想为了自己那点邪恶目的而利用你身体的女孩手里救出来。

lines.en: : But I like it when my body is used for nefarious purposes.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢自己的身体被用在邪恶的目的上。

lines.en: : Then kindly ask them to hold it in for like thirty minutes while I yell at you for being such an idiot. Which is {i}another{/i} privilege I have as your cool older sister.
lines.zh: : 那就麻烦你让她们先忍个三十分钟,好让我骂你是个大白痴。这是我作为你那超酷的姐姐的{i}另一项{/i}特权。

lines.en: : So are you just going to cozy up to {i}everyone{/i} I love, or what?
lines.zh: : 那么,你打算跟我爱的{i}每一个人{/i}都套近乎,还是怎样?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha22
: Maybe. I can’t find Yumi, though. Have you seen her anywhere? I’ve decided to date her next.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过我找不到 Yumi。你在哪儿见过她吗?我决定了,下一个要交往的就是她。

lines.en: : So that’s...the path you’re taking, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 所以这就是……你要走的路,Otoha?

lines.en: : What- dating Yumi? That was a joke. There are only like two girls in our class I’d consider dating and I’ve already tried that with one of them.
lines.zh: : 什么——跟 Yumi 交往?那是个玩笑。我们班只有大概两个女孩是我会考虑交往的,而其中一个我已经试过了。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha23
: Wait. Who’s the other one then?
lines.zh: : 等等。那另一个是谁?

lines.en: : Don’t {i}ask{/i} her, Rin! That makes it sound like you’re interested!
lines.zh: : 别{i}问{/i}她,Rin!那听起来像是你有兴趣!

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha24
: Ohhhh! Yeah, I get it.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦!是啊,我懂了。

lines.en: : Don’t “get it” either! What is that supposed to mean?!
lines.zh: : 别「懂了」!你这话什么意思?!

lines.en: : I can just totally see those two together.
lines.zh: : 我完全能想象她们两个在一起的样子。

lines.en: : Just what the hell is going on with you and Maya behind my back?
lines.zh: : 你和 Maya 背着我到底在搞什么鬼?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha25
: Nothing, unfortunately. At least outside of my dreams.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有,很遗憾。至少在我的梦之外没有。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha26
: Enough chit-chat, though! You’re coming with me.
lines.zh: : 不过寒暄到此为止!你跟我走。

lines.en: scene sky
: H-Hey! Otoha! Who do you think are just stealing people away from...other people all the time! Bring Sensei back here! Rin and I have daddy issues that need to be resolved!
lines.zh: : 喂——喂!Otoha!你以为自己是谁啊,老是当着别人的面把人从……别人身边抢走!把 Sensei 带回来!我和 Rin 还有父亲情结没解决呢!

lines.en: : Yeah, and I need to go resolve them.
lines.zh: : 是啊,而我要去解决了。

lines.en: : Maybe trying to resolve your {i}own{/i} issues first would be a better idea, hm?
lines.zh: : 也许先试着解决你{i}自己{/i}的问题会是个更好的主意,嗯?

lines.en: : Ugh, but that’s so {i}hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃,可那也太{i}难{/i}了。

lines.en: : The best things in life normally are.
lines.zh: : 生活中最好的东西通常都很难。

lines.en: : Ahh. You mean like a penis.
lines.zh: : 啊。你是说像鸡巴那样的东西。

lines.en: : Yup. The best thing in life is definitely the penis. That’s why I’ve only had romantic feelings for girls.
lines.zh: : 对。生命中最好的东西绝对是鸡巴。所以我对女孩才只有浪漫的感情。

lines.en: : There’s a spark between us, Otoha. I know you can feel it too.
lines.zh: : 我们之间有火花,Otoha。我知道你也感觉得到。

lines.en: : Mhm. And I can’t control it anymore! Please! Take me, Sensei! Right now!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。而且我已经控制不住了!求你了!占有我吧,Sensei!就现在!

lines.en: : Chika, as a fellow Sensei-liker, do you ever find yourself fantasizing about Sensei with other girls?
lines.zh: : Chika,作为同样喜欢 Sensei 的人,你有没有幻想过 Sensei 和别的女孩在一起?

lines.en: : Specifically girls you have dated before? And that, instead of actively participating in said fantasy, you’re sort of just off to the side watching and touching yourself?
lines.zh: : 特别是你以前交往过的女孩?而且在那幻想里,你并不主动参与,只是站在一边看着、自己摸自己?

lines.en: : {i}See!{/i} I told you she was going to destroy you again! Keep that whore out of your fantasies and just...put some other girl in there instead! One you like more! Who won’t hurt you!
lines.zh: : {i}看吧{/i}!我就说她会再毁你一次!把那个婊子从你的幻想里赶出去,然后……换个别女孩进去!换个你更喜欢的!不会伤害你的!

lines.en: : You mean, like...Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你是说,比如……Futaba?

lines.en: : Not like Futaba!
lines.zh: : 别是 Futaba!

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha27
: Otoha — we’ve been walking for five minutes and I haven’t “taken” you yet. When do we get to that part?
lines.zh: : Otoha——我们已经走了五分钟了,你还没「占有」我。那部分什么时候才到?

lines.en: : Whenever my last ounce of self-respect has faded away. So, I don’t know — another month or two, maybe?
lines.zh: : 等我最后一丝自尊心消失殆尽的时候吧。所以,我不知道——也许再过一两个月?

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll wait. But I’m formally requesting that you wear that swimsuit when I {i}do{/i} get to take you because it does a great job of accentuating your surprisingly hot body.
lines.zh: : 行。我等。不过我正式请求你,等我{i}真{/i}能占有你的时候穿上那件泳衣,因为它把你那意外火辣的身体衬托得特别好。

lines.en: : Why is my hotness surprising to you?
lines.zh: : 我的火辣有什么好让你意外的?

lines.en: : I think it’s mostly just because you’re always wearing pants. Which is probably another reason I like your pajamas so much.
lines.zh: : 我想多半只是因为你总穿着长裤。大概这也是我那么喜欢你那身睡衣的另一个原因。

lines.en: : Really laying it on thick today, huh? Has not having your childhood girlfriend around to {i}relieve{/i} you every morning finally driven you mad?
lines.zh: : 今天是真下猛料啊?没有青梅竹马的女友每天早上帮你「{i}疏导{/i}」,终于把你逼疯了吗?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha28
: Tch. I was worried that’s where we were heading.
lines.zh: : 啧。我就担心话题会往这边走。

lines.en: : She told you, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她告诉你了,对吧?

lines.en: : She told me {i}a lot.{/i} Way more than I’d expect her to given our...history. But, you’ll be proud to know that I did not attempt to kiss her while she was at her most vulnerable this time.
lines.zh: : 她跟我讲了{i}很多{/i}。多到超出我的预期,考虑到我们的……过往。不过你会很欣慰地知道,这一次她最脆弱的时候,我没有试图去亲她。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re too busy liking {i}Maya{/i} instead now.
lines.zh: : 是啊,你现在忙着改喜欢 {i}Maya{/i} 了。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha29
: Not at all. Niki will always be my number one. She’s the perfect girl, after all.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。Niki 永远是我的第一位。她毕竟是完美的女孩。

lines.en: : Wow. I feel a lot better now, Otoha. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 哇。我现在感觉好多了,Otoha。谢谢。

lines.en: : I think you’re misunderstanding something, Sensei. I don’t {i}want{/i} to make you feel better.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你误会了什么,Sensei。我并不{i}想{/i}让你感觉好一点。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha30
: I want you to know that you’re the biggest idiot in the whole wide world for letting a girl like that get away! Were you dropped on your head as a child? Because it sure seems like it!
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道,你让那样一个女孩从身边溜走,是全天下最大的白痴!你小时候脑袋被摔过吗?因为看起来真的很像!

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha31
: Oh, look! We’re finally here!
lines.zh: : 哦,看!我们终于到了!

lines.en: scene black
: Finally where? I don’t see-
lines.zh: : 终于到哪儿了?我没看见——

lines.en: : Sit.
Otoha darts behind me and pushes me onto...
lines.zh: Otoha 闪到我身后,一把把我推到了……

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha32
A fucking banana boat.
lines.zh: 一只该死的香蕉船上。

lines.en: : Did we really walk all the way over here just to talk on a giant banana again?
lines.zh: : 我们真的走了这么远,就为了又在一根巨大的香蕉上说话?

lines.en: : I figured that being called an idiot on top of a giant, buoyant fruit would lessen the impact on your already minuscule self-esteem.
lines.zh: : 我想,在一颗巨大而浮力十足的水果上被人骂白痴,应该能减轻对你那本就微乎其微的自尊心造成的冲击。

lines.en: : Yeah, I might as well replace my couch with one at this point. Now, go on. Hit me. Say all you need to say about how much I fucked things up.
lines.zh: : 是啊,到这一步,我不如把家里的沙发也换成一根算了。好了,来吧。尽管说。把你想说的、关于我把事情弄得多糟的话,全都说出来。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha33
: I will! But first, let me congratulate you!
lines.zh: : 我会的!不过首先,让我恭喜你!

lines.en: : I truly believed it was {i}impossible{/i} to disappoint so many people at once. But you managed to disappoint {i}millions{/i} by breaking a famous idol and essentially forcing her into retirement!
lines.zh: : 我真的以为,要同时让那么多人失望是{i}不可能{/i}的。可你做到了让{i}数百万人{/i}失望——你伤了一个著名偶像的心,基本上把她逼退了圈!

lines.en: : It’s a new high score! You finally did it! You just {i}now{/i} have to live with the weight of never being able to surpass it. So it’s all downhill from here, buddy.
lines.zh: : 这是新纪录!你终于做到了!只不过{i}从今往后{/i},你得背负着「再也无法超越」的重量活下去。所以接下来就全是下坡路了,老兄。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...if it makes you feel better, I’m definitely not happy with myself.
lines.zh: : 是啊,嗯……如果这能让你好受点的话,我对自己绝对不满意。

lines.en: : Now, why the ever-loving {i}fuck{/i} would that make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 那{i}他妈的{/i}到底为什么会让我好受一点?

lines.en: : Beats me. But you’re smiling pretty fucking aggressively right now, so I can only imagine you’re enjoying this.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过你现在笑得他妈的相当来劲,所以我只能想象你很享受。

lines.en: : I am smiling out of sheer disbelief, not {i}joy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是因为难以置信才笑的,不是因为{i}高兴{/i}。

lines.en: : Like, I always knew you’d manage to fuck things up with her, sure. But having her walk in on you fucking her little sister is, like...{i}what?{/i} Really? You’re {i}starting{/i} with the killing blow?
lines.zh: : 就是说啊,我当然一直知道你会跟她搞砸。可让她撞见你在操她亲妹妹,这是……{i}什么{/i}?真的吗?你{i}一上来{/i}就放绝杀?

lines.en: : {size=-1}So not only is the love of her life cheating on her, but he’s cheating on her with a teenager. And not {i}only{/i} is she a teenager, it’s her little sister. You couldn’t write a soap opera more dramatic than that.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}所以不光是一生挚爱在出轨,出轨对象还是个未成年。而且{i}不光{/i}是未成年,还是她的亲妹妹。你都写不出比这更狗血的肥皂剧了。{/size}

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it have made more sense to cheat on her with an adult first? You know? Sort of {i}ease{/i} her into the fact that you’re an insatiable pervert who’ll fuck anything that moves?
lines.zh: : 先跟个成年人出轨,不是更说得通吗?你知道的,好让她{i}慢慢接受{/i}这样一个事实:你是个欲壑难填的变态,只要是会动的东西你都想操?

lines.en: : Otoha, I don’t know what you want me to say here. I can’t justify it. I can’t even {i}explain{/i} it. But it happened, and now I’m paying the price.
lines.zh: : Otoha,我不知道你想让我说什么。我没法为它辩解。我甚至没法{i}解释{/i}它。可事情已经发生了,现在我正在付出代价。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha34
: It’s not {i}just{/i} Niki who left either. Ami’s gone too. She’s been staying at the dorms ever since it happened.
lines.zh: : 离开的也不{i}只是{/i} Niki。Ami 也走了。从那事发生之后,她就一直住在宿舍。

lines.en: : So Niki’s just not coming to your place {i}at all{/i} anymore? Because she told me she was.
lines.zh: : 那 Niki 就{i}再也不{/i}来你家了吗?因为她跟我说她会来。

lines.en: : She stops by to pick things up and do laundry, but she doesn’t talk to me. She doesn’t even {i}look{/i} at me. I’ve been entirely alone in there, and it’s driving me insane.
lines.zh: : 她会过来拿东西、洗衣服,可她不跟我说话。她连{i}看{/i}都不看我。我一个人在那屋里待着,这快把我逼疯了。

lines.en: : Or...{i}more{/i} insane, I guess. There’s sort of a baseline level of insanity that can be assumed in regard to me since my track record shows me doing shit like this all the time.
lines.zh: : 或者……{i}更{/i}疯,我想。反正关于我,本来就有个可以想见的基准疯度,毕竟我的前科表明我一直在干这种事。

lines.en: : Well, if it makes {i}you{/i} feel any better, you are definitely not the only one suffering. In fact, if anything, I’d say Niki has it like ten times worse than you.
lines.zh: : 嗯,如果这能让{i}你{/i}好受一点的话,受苦的绝对不止你一个。事实上,要我说,Niki 的处境比你惨上十倍。

lines.en: : Because {i}you’re{/i} still out here having fun and flirting with girls. {i}She{/i} hasn’t even been able to practice lately. So her entire album is on hold right now while she “recovers.”
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}还在外面玩得开心、跟女孩们调情。而{i}她{/i}最近连练习都做不了。所以她整张专辑现在都搁置了,等她「恢复」。

lines.en: : Still has time to meet with you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过还是有时间见你。

lines.en: : Yeah. But my singing lessons have essentially turned into “Otoha’s counseling hour” where I just watch her cry and internally debate whether or not I should pat her on the back or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊。可我的声乐课基本上已经变成了「Otoha 心理咨询时间」——我就看着她哭,同时在心里纠结要不要拍拍她的背什么的。

lines.en: : You have {i}fucked that girl up.{/i} And I don’t think time alone is going to fix that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : {i}你把那姑娘彻底搞坏了{/i}。而且我不觉得光靠时间就能治好,Sensei。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha35
: But, {i}at the same time,{/i} I don’t think I’ve ever seen Noriko {i}happier.{/i} Just that happiness comes at the cost of the rift you sowed between her and Niki. So, like...{i}what the fuck?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可{i}与此同时{/i},我从没见过 Noriko {i}那么幸福{/i}过。只是那份幸福,是以你在她和 Niki 之间种下的裂痕为代价的。所以,那个……{i}到底他妈的算什么{/i}?

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} don’t want to be in the middle of this. But I feel like I {i}have{/i} to at this point or Niki will essentially just remain invisible to you and things will {i}never{/i} get better.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}不想夹在中间。可我觉得事到如今我{i}不得不{/i}这么做,否则 Niki 对你来说基本上就会一直是隐形的,而事情{i}永远都不会{/i}好转。

lines.en: : What now, then?
lines.zh: : 那现在怎么办?

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha36
: Dude, you tell me. {i}I{/i} can’t fix this for you. But I don’t want to just sit around while my favorite lopsided power couple breaks up either.
lines.zh: : 老兄,你告诉我。{i}我{/i}可没法替你修好这个。但我也不想就干坐着,看着我最喜欢的那对失衡的强档情侣分手。

lines.en: : Can’t you just...{i}talk{/i} to her?
lines.zh: : 你就不能……跟她{i}谈谈{/i}吗?

lines.en: : And disregard her wishes? Sure. But she told me she wants space, so that’s what I’ll give her.
lines.zh: : 然后无视她的意愿?是啊。可她说了她想要空间,那我就给她空间。

lines.en: : Isn’t fucking her sister sort of “disregarding her wishes” as well? Or is that a wish you were just {i}okay{/i} with disregarding because you got something out of it?
lines.zh: : 操她妹妹,不也算是一种「无视她的意愿」吗?还是说,那是个你{i}无所谓{/i}无视的意愿,因为你从中得到了好处?

lines.en: : It wasn’t just...{i}something,{/i} Otoha. I wasn’t thinking about Niki when it happened. Just Noriko. And Noriko’s been silently suffering {i}forever{/i} because of me.
lines.zh: : 那不只是……{i}某种好处{/i},Otoha。事情发生的时候,我脑子里没有 Niki。只有 Noriko。而 Noriko 因为我,已经默默承受了{i}太久太久{/i}。

lines.en: : She’s {i}actually{/i} like a sister to me. She didn’t just start pretending to be one like you are now.
lines.zh: : 她对我来说{i}真的{/i}像个妹妹。她可不像你这样,是现在才开始假装的。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha37
: Was that really necessary?...
lines.zh: : 那句话真的有必要说吗?……

lines.en: : I don’t know...I’ve got no fucking clue.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我他妈一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: : You really think I’d spend this much time and energy on you if I was just {i}pretending?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真觉得,如果我只是{i}假装{/i},我会花这么多时间和精力在你身上吗?……

lines.en: : {size=-1}I’m an only child, Sensei. I don’t have the {i}luxury{/i} of actually knowing what it’s like to be a sibling. Or the {i}history{/i} of growing up beside you. So are my feelings just invalid because of that?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}我是独生女,Sensei。我没有那份{i}福气{/i},去真正知道做别人的兄弟姐妹是什么感觉。也没有那份与你一起长大的{i}过往{/i}。所以,我的感情就因此不作数了吗?{/size}

lines.en: : No...they’re not.
lines.zh: : 不……不是的。

lines.en: : I just have a hard time figuring out who’s being authentic and who isn’t. So I sort of assume everyone {i}isn’t{/i} by default.
lines.zh: : 我只是很难分清谁是真诚的、谁不是。所以我干脆默认所有人{i}都不真诚{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} though? Who do you actually know that {i}isn’t{/i} authentic? Because everyone {i}I{/i} know that {i}you{/i} know genuinely cares. {i}Too{/i} much even.
lines.zh: : 可{i}为什么{/i}呢?你到底认识哪个{i}不真诚{/i}的人?因为{i}我{/i}认识、{i}你{/i}也认识的每一个人,都是真心在乎你的。甚至在在乎得{i}过头{/i}了。

lines.en: : Nowadays, no one. But this outlook isn’t exactly {i}new.{/i} A lot of shit happened to me well before you were even {i}born,{/i} Otoha.
lines.zh: : 如今,一个也没有。不过这种看法也算不上{i}新鲜{/i}。很多破事发生在我身上的时候,你甚至还没{i}出生{/i}呢,Otoha。

lines.en: : {i}Okay.{/i} But are you really going to let that define you for the rest of your pathetic existence? Just fucking grow up, dude. The past is the past. Niki’s here {i}now.{/i} And she needs you.
lines.zh: : {i}好吧{/i}。可你真要让那件事定义你余下这可怜的一生吗?他妈的成熟点吧,老兄。过去的事就让它过去。Niki {i}就在这儿{/i}。而她需要你。

lines.en: : No, I need her.
lines.zh: : 不,是我需要她。

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha38
: {i}No.{/i} She needs {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}。是她需要{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : She was fine without me for-
lines.zh: : 她没有我也过得挺好的,都好些——

lines.en: scene beachsixotoha39
: She was absolutely {i}not{/i} fine without you for {i}years.{/i} She was an obsessive loner who became engulfed in her work out of sheer spite toward you.
lines.zh: : 她没有你的{i}那些年{/i},绝对过得一点都{i}不{/i}好。她是个偏执的独行侠,纯粹是冲着你赌气,才一头扎进了工作里。

lines.en: : She was {i}never{/i} happy. {i}Never{/i} comfortable. And she drifted from hotel room to hotel room every single night, waiting for the {i}slightest{/i} hint that you still gave a shit.
lines.zh: : 她{i}从来没有{/i}幸福过。{i}从来没有{/i}舒坦过。她每天晚上从一间酒店房间漂到另一间,等着{i}哪怕一丝{/i}你还把她放在心上的迹象。

lines.en: : And even now, after you have done the {i}worst{/i} possible thing to her, she is {i}still{/i} obsessed and {i}still{/i} wants to figure out how to make something that will never work {i}work.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而即便是现在,在你对她做了{i}最糟糕{/i}的事情之后,她{i}依然{/i}痴迷,{i}依然{/i}想弄明白,该怎么让一件永远不可能有结果的事{i}有结果{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is true codependency. Not this “moping around and helping teenage girls resolve their daddy issues” bullshit you’re already on after being here for twenty minutes.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}才是真正的相互依赖。而不是你才来了二十分钟就已经开始干的这套——「四处唉声叹气、帮女高中生解决父亲情结」的破事。

lines.en: : Just {i}go{/i} to her. Show her that you still care.
lines.zh: : 就{i}去{/i}找她吧。让她看到你还在乎。

lines.en: : And then what? Hurt her again?
lines.zh: : 然后呢?再伤她一次?

lines.en: : {size=-2}{i}Yeah.{/i} Hurt her again. As many times as you have to. Because it might not seem like it, but that’s better for her than just being indefinitely neglected when she has sworn to be {i}yours{/i} for the rest of her life.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}{i}对{/i}。再伤她一次。要多少次就多少次。因为也许看起来不是这样,可对一个发誓余生都{i}属于你{/i}的女人来说,这总比被无限期地冷落要好。{/size}

lines.en: : I just don’t want her to {i}be{/i} like that anymore, Otoha. I want her to move on and find someone who {i}won’t{/i} hurt her. Then I can just...hurt in her place.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让她再那样了,Otoha。我希望她往前走,去找一个{i}不会{/i}伤害她的人。那样我就可以……替她承受痛苦。

lines.en: : Well, tough fucking shit because that’s not how her stupid obsessive idol brain works. Niki will die with a body-count of one if you never see her again.
lines.zh: : 哼,那可真是操蛋,因为她那颗又蠢又偏执的偶像脑袋不是这么运转的。要是你再也不见她,Niki 这辈子死的时候,身旁也就只有过一个男人。

lines.en: : How's she supposed to find someone else when her taste in men is just “the worst man on earth?” Because there can only {i}be{/i} one worst man on earth, and that man is clearly you.
lines.zh: : 她挑男人的品味就是「全世界最烂的男人」,那要她怎么去找别人?因为全世界最烂的男人只能{i}有{/i}一个,而那个人显然就是你。

lines.en: : You really do know exactly what to say to make all of my troubles fade away, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 你真是太知道该说什么,才能让我所有的烦恼烟消云散了,Otoha。

lines.en: : Sensei. You are making a {i}mistake.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei。你在犯一个{i}错误{/i}。

lines.en: : You don’t like being away from her. {i}She{/i} doesn’t like being away from {i}you.{/i} Fuck her space. Fuck {i}your{/i} moping. Just...tell her you’re sorry and fuck her sister in private from now on.
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢离开她。{i}她{/i}也不喜欢离开{i}你{/i}。去她的空间。去{i}你的{/i}自怨自艾。就……去跟她说对不起,然后从今往后,操她妹妹时也别让她看见。

lines.en: : Do you really think she’s that dependent on me?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得她对我依赖到了那种地步?

lines.en: : {size=-1}A thousand times yes. And I’m low-key worried that something in the water is causing it because your fucking weirdo niece is the same exact way and everyone {i}else{/i} is slowly becoming like that too.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}千真万确。而且我还有点私下担心,是水里的什么东西在作怪,因为你那个他妈的怪胎侄女也完全一个德性,而{i}其他所有人{/i}也在慢慢变成那样。{/size}

lines.en: : Daughter.
lines.zh: : 女儿。
